args.query: SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.name AS account_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spending FROM posting p JOIN account a ON p.credit_account_id = a.id WHERE p.org_id = 'org_indian_demo' AND a.type @> ARRAY['BANK']::text[] GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY total_spending DESC LIMIT 1
args.description: Find the banking account with the maximum total spending (credit postings).

args.result_summary: Identified the banking account with the maximum spending: Checking Account (ID: acco_org_indian_demo_1102) with a total spending of 97500.0.

args.query: SELECT a.name AS category_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spending FROM posting p JOIN account a ON p.account_id = a.id WHERE p.org_id = 'org_indian_demo' AND p.credit_account_id = 'acco_org_indian_demo_1102' GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY total_spending DESC LIMIT 1
args.description: Find the contra account (category) with the highest total spending for the banking account with the maximum spending.

args.query:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN p.account_id = 'acco_org_indian_demo_1102' THEN ca.name 
        ELSE da.name 
    END AS category_name, 
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_spending 
FROM posting p 
JOIN account da ON p.account_id = da.id 
JOIN account ca ON p.credit_account_id = ca.id 
WHERE p.org_id = 'org_indian_demo' 
  AND (p.account_id = 'acco_org_indian_demo_1102' OR p.credit_account_id = 'acco_org_indian_demo_1102') 
  AND (da.id != 'acco_org_indian_demo_1102' OR ca.id != 'acco_org_indian_demo_1102') 
GROUP BY category_name 
ORDER BY total_spending DESC 
LIMIT 1

args.query:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p.account_id = 'acco_org_indian_demo_1102' THEN ca.name
    WHEN p.credit_account_id = 'acco_org_indian_demo_1102' THEN da.name
  END AS contra_account_name,
  SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount
FROM posting p
JOIN account da ON p.account_id = da.id
JOIN account ca ON p.credit_account_id = ca.id
WHERE p.org_id = 'org_indian_demo'
  AND (p.account_id = 'acco_org_indian_demo_1102' OR p.credit_account_id = 'acco_org_indian_demo_1102')
GROUP BY
  contra_account_name
ORDER BY
  total_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;
